verdict.rationale: Plaid documents Auth, Balance, Identity and Transactions as separate products. All of them are accessed through Plaid Link, the single client-side component users go through to link accounts [plaid-docs-5]. The Sandbox endpoint accepts a set of 'initial products' for one Item [plaid-docs-14], and a community report notes that a single Plaid flow grants transactions, identity and real-time balance together [plaid-comm-3]. Together these imply one connection can feed multiple products, but no first-party doc states it directly. Missing for 10: explicit docs showing a single link_token/Link session configured with multiple products (auth, balance, transactions, identity), docs on adding products to an existing Item without re-linking, and hands-on developer corroboration.
